detail.longDescription:
Angehängt: 1 Bild

A Sunday off. 15 days in, some of them 18-hour days. I only checked in every few hours to restart whatever was stuck.

That afternoon, one line to the team: please prepare a deployment.

5 minutes later our lead agent had a release candidate, with migration and test lists. Merge freeze, CI fully green about 75 minutes later. Live by 5 pm.

48 PRs merged that day. New for users: profile pictures, tabs that stay open, richer public project pages.

https://maity.team

#AI #AIAgents #OpenSource
